verdict.rationale: Secureframe's vendor risk management documents a vendor inventory with profiles, risk assessments, attachments and history logs. SSO-based shadow-IT detection keeps the vendor list current, it claims continuous vendor security-posture monitoring, and it supports recurring reviews scheduled by risk level. However, nothing in the evidence documents tracking each vendor's data access, and all support is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: documented per-vendor data-access tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration of the vendor review workflow

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Find details like vendor profiles, vendor risk assessments, document attachments, and vendor history logs in the vendor tab in-app.
ensuring that your active vendor list stays up-to-date
Continuously monitor and track your vendors' security posture so you can do business with minimal risk.
Users can also set up recurring reviews based on risk level, and set up tasks and notifications via Jira and Slack.
Leverage Comply AI to automatically extract relevant answers to security review questions from vendor documents like SOC 2 reports and policies.
